title: glow-1999-heavyweight-championship
label: "Simply the Best" James Pillow

won.source: The promotion's own repeated billing of Pillow as reigning champion no later than mid-June 1999; no title-change broadcast survives in the held record.

note: Recorded from the promotion's own repeated billing. Retained the title in a disqualification win over a number-one contender in mid-June 1999 and again in a triple-threat title match at the promotion's own second pay-per-view on 26 June 1999, when a manager's own interference backfired onto a rival challenger.

title: glow-1999-northeast-championship
label: Victor V. Hill

won.source: The promotion's own repeated billing of Hill as reigning Northeast Champion no later than late June 1999; no title-change broadcast survives in the held record.

note: Recorded from the promotion's own repeated billing. Not defended on either of the two broadcasts held in the held record; a number-one contender was crowned for a future defense at the promotion's own second pay-per-view on 26 June 1999.

title: glow-1999-tag-team-championship
label: The Perfectly Perfect Duo

won.source: The promotion's own repeated billing of the Perfectly Perfect Duo as reigning tag-team champions no later than late June 1999; no title-change broadcast survives in the held record.

note: Retained the title against a rival tag team at the promotion's own second pay-per-view on 26 June 1999, accompanied by a manager whose own interference was a factor in a separate match the same night.
